changeSet.sql: WITH exact_refs AS ( SELECT indicator_id, min(ref_target) target FROM gov_indicator_reference WHERE ref_type = 'MODEL_SPEC_FIELD' GROUP BY indicator_id HAVING count(*) = 1 ) UPDATE gov_indicator_definition i SET implementation_ref = jsonb_build_object( 'modelSpecId', split_part(r.target, '@', 1), 'modelRevision', split_part(split_part(r.target, '@', 2), '#', 1)::integer, 'fieldName', split_part(r.target, '#', 2)) FROM exact_refs r WHERE r.indicator_id = i.id AND r.target ~ '^[0-9a-fA-F]{8}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{12}@[1-9][0-9]{0,8}#[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*$';

CREATE TABLE modeling_catalog_indicator_serving_projection ( tenant_id varchar(128) NOT NULL, indicator_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES gov_indicator_definition(id), indicator_version varchar(32) NOT NULL, sync_status varchar(32) NOT NULL, sync_attempts integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, version bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, mapping jsonb, last_sync_error varchar(500), next_sync_at timestamptz, updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(), PRIMARY KEY (tenant_id, indicator_id, indicator_version), CHECK (sync_status IN ('SYNC_PENDING','SYNCED','SYNC_FAILED')) ); CREATE INDEX idx_indicator_serving_due ON modeling_catalog_indicator_serving_projection(next_sync_at) WHERE sync_status IN ('SYNC_PENDING','SYNC_FAILED'); INSERT INTO modeling_catalog_indicator_serving_projection(tenant_id,indicator_id,indicator_version,sync_status,next_sync_at) SELECT 'default',v.indicator_id,v.version,'SYNC_PENDING',now() FROM gov_indicator_version v JOIN gov_indicator_definition d ON d.id=v.indicator_id WHERE v.status='PUBLISHED' AND d.metric_type IS NOT NULL AND coalesce(d.category,'') NOT IN ('MODIFIER','TIME_PERIOD');
